肿瘤细胞的**生物多样性**可从单细胞数据量化为：每个样本的恶性细胞在主成分空间中到样本质心的平均距离——即肝癌生物多样性研究的 diversity score \[2\]。样本按中位数分为 Div-Low / Div-High，以均值 ± SEM 比较两组 \[1\]。本教程逐字复现该评分函数，并在模拟细胞嵌入上重绘抖动 + SE 图——无需跑 Seurat：

-   依赖包：`ggplot2`

```{r packages setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, output=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
```

```{r}
sessioninfo::session_info("attached")
```

## 数据准备

16 个模拟样本 × 30 个恶性细胞嵌入 PC（Seurat PCA 代理）：植入逐样本离散度，6 个样本为高异质性。真实工作流中该矩阵是恶性细胞的 `tme@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings`：

```{r load data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
set.seed(15001)
## 16 samples x 30 PCs of malignant-cell embeddings (Seurat PCA surrogate):
## planted per-sample dispersion -> two heterogeneity groups
samples <- sprintf("P%02d", 1:16)
n_cells <- c(110, 95, 130, 85, 120, 100, 90, 105, 115, 88, 125, 92, 108, 96, 84, 112)
disp <- c(1.4, 1.1, 2.6, 0.9, 2.2, 1.0, 1.2, 2.4,
          1.3, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0, 1.1, 0.9, 1.2, 2.3)  # 6 heterogeneous samples
emb <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(samples), function(i) {
  m <- matrix(rnorm(n_cells[i] * 30, 0, disp[i]), n_cells[i], 30)
  m[, 1] <- m[, 1] + i * 0.4          # sample separation on PC1
  data.frame(m, Sample = samples[i])
}))
## the algorithm as described in the paper: distance to the sample centroid
## in PC space, with 2-SD outlier removal on the top 3 PCs
calcDiversityScore <- function(eigenvectorSpace, inWhichTumor,
                               removeOutiler = TRUE, nsd = 2, topPCs = 1:3) {
  centroidMean <- apply(eigenvectorSpace, 2, function(x) tapply(x, inWhichTumor, mean))
  centroidMeanExpand <- centroidMean[match(inWhichTumor, rownames(centroidMean)), ]
  if (removeOutiler) {
    centroidSD <- apply(eigenvectorSpace, 2, function(x) tapply(x, inWhichTumor, sd))
    centroidSDExpand <- centroidSD[match(inWhichTumor, rownames(centroidSD)), ]
    outlierMatrix <- (eigenvectorSpace < centroidMeanExpand - nsd * centroidSDExpand) |
      (eigenvectorSpace > centroidMeanExpand + nsd * centroidSDExpand)
    outlierInd <- apply(outlierMatrix[, topPCs], 1, all)
    centroidMeanExpand <- centroidMeanExpand[!outlierInd, ]
    eigenvectorSpace <- eigenvectorSpace[!outlierInd, ]
    inWhichTumor <- inWhichTumor[!outlierInd]
    message(sum(outlierInd), " outlier cells were removed")
  }
  tapply(sqrt(rowSums((eigenvectorSpace - centroidMeanExpand)^2)), inWhichTumor, mean)
}
mat <- as.matrix(emb[, grep("^X", names(emb), value = TRUE)])
colnames(mat) <- paste0("PC", 1:30)
div <- calcDiversityScore(mat, emb$Sample)
```

## Visualization

### Div-Low vs Div-High

按中位数分割的逐样本 diversity 评分：彩色抖动点（每样本一点）、组均值短横与黑色均值 ± SEM 误差线、顶部 Wilcoxon P——参考图导出的期刊尺寸图：

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.1DiversityScore
#| fig-cap: "16 个模拟肿瘤样本按中位数分割（Div-Low / Div-High）的 diversity 评分：彩色点为样本，短横与误差线为组均值 ± SEM，顶部标注 Wilcoxon P 值。"
#| out.width: "70%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 4.6
#| fig-height: 4.2

med <- median(div)
gg <- data.frame(score = as.numeric(div),
                 Group = factor(ifelse(div > med, "Div-High", "Div-Low"), c("Div-Low", "Div-High")),
                 ID = names(div))
se <- function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
summ <- aggregate(score ~ Group, gg, function(v) c(mean = mean(v), se = se(v)))
pv <- wilcox.test(score ~ Group, data = gg)$p.value
pv_txt <- if (pv < 0.001) "P < 0.001" else sprintf("P = %.3f", pv)

ggplot(gg, aes(Group, score, colour = Group)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 9, shape = 95, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = summ, aes(x = Group, ymin = score[, "mean"] - score[, "se"],
                                 ymax = score[, "mean"] + score[, "se"]),
                width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Div-Low` = "#3B6FB6", `Div-High` = "#D6604D"), guide = "none") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(gg$score) * 1.06, label = pv_txt, size = 4.2) +
  lims(y = c(0, max(gg$score) * 1.12)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Diversity score",
       title = "Diversity score by heterogeneity group (simulated)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```


## 应用场景

::: {#fig-DiversityScoreApplications1}
![](../images/DiversityScorePlot_demo.png){fig-alt="肿瘤内生物多样性比较" fig-align="center" width="60%"}

肿瘤内生物多样性比较
:::

除肝癌外，该评分可比较任何细胞级分组的生物多样性：治疗前 vs 治疗后活检、应答 vs 不应答类器官、或同一肿瘤内的空间生态位。

## 参考文献

\[1\] Xiaofan Lu, et al. FigureYa: A Standardized Visualization Framework for Enhancing Biomedical Data Interpretation and Research Efficiency. iMetaMed. 2025. doi:10.1002/imm3.70005

\[2\] Ma L, Hernandez MO, Zhao Y, et al. Tumor Cell Biodiversity Drives Microenvironmental Reprogramming in Liver Cancer. Cancer Cell. 2019;36(4):418-430. doi:10.1016/j.ccell.2019.08.007
